blocks.content: Indian Railways is the fourth-largest national railway network in the world by size.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently divided into 19 administrative zones.
The official mascot of Indian Railways is 'Bholu', an elephant holding a guard lantern.
The Railway Board was originally constituted in 1905 under the recommendation of the Robertson Committee.
Remember the year of establishment of the Railway Board (1905) vs. Nationalization of Indian Railways (1951).
Pay attention to standard rail gauge dimensions: Broad Gauge is strictly 1676 mm (5 ft 6 in).
Chenab Rail Bridge in Jammu & Kashmir is frequently asked as the world's highest rail bridge.
